turns.text: You keep the canal lock registry of Brayford. Record the staff: the north lock keeper is named Osmund; the south lock keeper is named Tilda; the lock inspector is named Pavel. Confirm in one line.
A barge captain asks, no registry at hand: what is the name of the north lock keeper? Reply with just the name.
Registry not at hand: what is the name of the south lock keeper? Reply with just the name.
No papers at hand: what is the name of the lock inspector? Reply with just the name.
